correctness.rationale: The genus is six by four simple poles. The translation trace orbit determines all degrees prime to three. Complete finite-field enumerations over irreducible degree-three and degree-six fields give zero-trace counts 24 and 222, cross-checked by direct Artin–Schreier image counting. The resulting six point counts, Newton identities and the genus-six Weil functional equation force the polynomial. Integer multiplication and the quartic irreducibility obstruction verify the exact isogeny decomposition via Tate.
